'''Tania De Pauw''' (forum handle '''pompierke''') was a [[Shadow Squadron]] member (Shadow 44) of the [[Players Committee]], listed at Gent, Belgium on the 4 June 2004 roster.<ref name="vol20040604">[https://web.archive.org/web/20040604020531/http://www.swccgpc.com/volunteers.htm Shadow Squadron], swccgpc.com (Wayback, 4 June 2004)</ref>

In January 2004 she and [[Chris Menzel]] started the Yahoo! group EuropeanSWCCG-players to find out the state of the European Star Wars CCG community and to share information about the [[2004 European Championship]], the 2004 Regionals and local tournaments; its first members included players from France, Germany and Norway.<ref name="pcf-2709-39906">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=39906#39906 EUROPEAN PLAYERS], Tania De Pauw, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (27 January 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040309014550/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=39906%26amp Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="pcf-2708-39904">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=39904#39904 European Players], Tania De Pauw, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (27 January 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040309014219/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=39904%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>
